titulo: The lids swapped, and both close
caption:
The lids swapped, and both close

The small lid sat on the big box and the big lid on the small one. Swapped, both of them closed.

A lid that almost fits lets the air in, and swapping two lids takes less time than the first look.

For whoever swaps the mismatched lids so each box closes properly.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a big clear container and a small one on the right, each wearing the wrong lid: a small lid sits on the big container and a big lid hangs over the small one. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the two lids hop across each other and land on the right containers. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: close enough, to: matched them. nothing leaks.
